ecrf.title: Data collection
ecrf.description: Live, dynamic data entry form populated from CDASH metadata with client-side field validation and real-time query management.
ecrf.cdashDesc: The fields on the left are dynamically rendered using structural CDASH metadata tags (e.g. DM.BRTHDT, VS.VSSBP).
ecrf.birthDateRule: Birth Date: Must match YYYY-MM-DD pattern.
ecrf.systolicBpRule: Systolic BP: Numeric value between 50 and 250 mmHg.
ecrf.diastolicBpRule: Diastolic BP: Numeric value between 30 and 150 mmHg.
ecrf.pulseRateRule: Pulse Rate: Numeric value between 30 and 200 bpm.
ecrf.queryManagementDesc: Click the query flags next to input fields to raise, answer, close, or reopen discrepancy notes. All query transitions are audit-logged in real-time.
